```plato
//==
// # Optimization solver parameters
//
// The tuning records of the standard iterative solvers, gradient-based and
// derivative-free. Each is a pure parameter record; the seeded population
// methods are deterministic given their Seed. The goals, stopping rules, and
// results these solvers share live in the first section above.

//==
// # Gradient-based solver parameters

// Tuning of gradient descent. LearningRate scales each step, Momentum in
// [0, 1) blends in the previous step, and Decay multiplies the learning rate
// after every iteration (1 keeps it constant).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gradient_descent)
type GradientDescentParameters
    implements IValue
{
    LearningRate: Number;
    Momentum: Number;
    Decay: Number;
}
```
